llm_response.reason: The site at bitinvestor.net impersonates the branding and regulatory claims of another legitimate business (swapped.com), but is not the domain of that business. The website uses all information and appearance relating to 'Swapped.com' and 'Swapped ApS', despite the domain name being unrelated, fulfilling scam characteristic #16 (mimics or spoofs legitimate company names, logos, and designs). The only hyperlink is to swapped.com's Trustpilot page. Domain registrant information does not explain any legitimate or contractual relationship to swapped.com, indicating an intent to deceive users seeking the real business. This kind of brand spoofing is common for cryptocurrency phishing and scam sites.
